triage.verifier_justification: The refutation attempt fails on the meaning-bearing half of the diff: both IEEPA component formulas in this generated chapter-49 composition gated the Brazil 9903.01.77 carve-out on `not entry_is_line_b`, and the branch's own proof atom in the pre file cites a membership proposition ("The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02"), while the commit's own `flag-action-map.md` states "`entry_is_line_b` — HTS 7601.10.30.00", i.e. the condition was the identity of one witness exemplar line, a concept the source never states. Resolving the source through the pinned release confirms the carve-out is by article class (9903.01.83: "Articles of iron or steel; derivative articles of iron or steel; articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum; ..."), so the fix re-grounds a source-less condition onto the membership the provision names — untraceable_branch, not amount, boundary, polarity, or a missing clause. The pre-fix state was merged content on main (the generated module came from 1bc7292f, "Generated tariff-schedule compositions, batch 2"), not an intra-PR staging artifact, so "enhancement the module never claimed" does not hold; the module always claimed to encode this exception. The steel half of the diff (9903.81.87/.88 → 9903.82.02, rate unchanged at 0.50) is mechanical provenance only, so the first reader's PR-body quote is not the decisive evidence — the Brazil gate line is.

triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 48 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Strongest surviving counter-arguments, for the reviewer: (1) For chapter 49 specifically the change is output-neutral — no printed-matter line is either the 7601.10.30.00 exemplar or a §232 aluminum article, so the Brazil surcharge applies either way; what is corrected is the encoded condition and the caller input contract, not a computed duty for this chapter. (2) The PR frames it as decoupling, and the generator applies it as a blind substring substitution across 100 chapters ("Exact witness substrings: every other gate and effective window is preserved" in tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py), with certified witness-slice equivalence under the input mapping — so this is a generated-artifact regeneration, not a targeted repair on ch49. I still call it fidelity because the pre-fix encoded condition disagreed with the cited source and the module already used the correct membership flag `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` for its own §232 aluminum component (pre lines 2744/2751) while using the positional flag for this carve-out. Two caveats: the fix is partial — 9903.01.83 also carves out steel, wood, vehicles, semiconductors and copper, and the post formula still excludes only aluminum; and `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still reads `formula: entry_is_line_b` at post line 1924, so an exemplar-flag gate remains in the same file. If a reviewer prefers a scope framing (exception applied to one exemplar line instead of the aluminum-article population), wrong_entity_or_scope is the runner-up kind; untraceable_branch fits better because the fix re-grounds a condition that had no counterpart in the source at all.
